scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dodo/sdk && concurrently -n sdk,checkout,demo -c cyan,green,white "npm run dev -w @dodo/sdk" "npm run dev -w @dodo/checkout" "npm run dev -w @dodo/demo"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dodo/sdk && npm run build -w @dodo/checkout && npm run build -w @dodo/demo
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sdk --noEmit && tsc -p apps/checkout --noEmit && tsc -p apps/demo --noEmit
